title: Home page

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Small uppercase label above the facts, e.g. "Про нас".

sub_fields.label: Facts
sub_fields.name: facts
sub_fields.instructions: Label/value rows in the left column (Founded, Founder, ...).

sub_fields.label: Heading
sub_fields.name: heading
sub_fields.instructions: Optional headline at the top of the right column, above the intro paragraph.

sub_fields.label: Description
sub_fields.name: description
sub_fields.instructions: Large intro paragraph in the right column.

sub_fields.label: Body text
sub_fields.name: content
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Smaller text under the intro paragraph: paragraphs and bulleted lists.

sub_fields.label: Pillars
sub_fields.name: pillars
sub_fields.instructions: Numbered columns below the intro. Numbers (01, 02, ...) follow the row order.

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Small uppercase label above the slider, e.g. "Концепції".

sub_fields.label: Slides
sub_fields.name: slides
sub_fields.instructions: One concept per slide. The counter (01 / 04) follows the row order. Images are cropped to 16:9.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under the slider and used as the image's alt text.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Landscape visualisation, at least 1920px wide. Without an image the slide shows a grey placeholder.

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Large heading of the section, e.g. "Наші проекти".

sub_fields.label: Projects
sub_fields.name: selected_projects
sub_fields.instructions: Projects shown in the section, in this order. The order also sets the "Project 03 / 10" counter and the previous/next links in the project window. The card layout repeats every 10 projects. Pick them on the Ukrainian page: the list is copied to other languages, and each language shows its own translation of every project (projects without one are hidden there).

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Large heading of the section, e.g. "Вироби".

sub_fields.label: Intro
sub_fields.name: intro
sub_fields.instructions: Short note next to the heading, e.g. "Оберіть серію, щоб переглянути світильники, фото та характеристики."

sub_fields.label: Series
sub_fields.name: selected_series
sub_fields.instructions: Series cards shown in the section (three per row), in this order; drag to reorder. Each card opens a window with the series' description and its products (ordered as in Products → Re-order). Pick them on the Ukrainian page: the list is copied to other languages, and each language shows its own translation of every series (series without one are hidden there).

sub_fields.label: Order form
sub_fields.name: order_form
sub_fields.instructions: Contact Form 7 form opened by the "contact us about an order" button in a product window. The product's name is filled into the form's "product" field (e.g. [hidden product]); add [product] to the form's mail body to receive it. Leave empty to make the button scroll to the contacts section instead. Pick it on the Ukrainian page: each language shows its own translation of the form.

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Large heading of the section, e.g. "Виробництво".

sub_fields.label: Section description
sub_fields.name: section_description
sub_fields.instructions: Short paragraph next to the heading.

sub_fields.label: Gallery
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: Photos and videos, in this order; drag to reorder. The layout (position and crop of each tile) repeats every 4 items. A photo opens full screen on click; a video plays in a full-screen player.

sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under the tile and in the full-screen view, e.g. a production stage.

sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: The photo (at least 1600px on the long side). For a video: its cover frame, shown on the tile and before playback starts; without one the tile is grey. A photo item without an image is not shown.

sub_fields.label: Video
sub_fields.name: video
sub_fields.instructions: WebM (VP9) or MP4 (H.264), ideally under 50 MB. For a WebM, also add an MP4 fallback below.

sub_fields.label: MP4 fallback
sub_fields.name: video_fallback
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. The same video as MP4 (H.264), played by browsers that can't play the WebM above (older iPhones and iPads).

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Small heading above the logo strip, e.g. "Партнери".

sub_fields.label: Logos
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: Partner logos, in this order; drag to reorder. They scroll in an endless strip, shown in grayscale and in color on hover. Use SVG or a transparent PNG trimmed to the logo edges. A row without a logo is not shown.

sub_fields.label: Name
sub_fields.name: name
sub_fields.instructions: Partner name, used as the logo's alt text.

sub_fields.label: Website
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Opens in a new tab.

sub_fields.label: Section title
sub_fields.name: section_title
sub_fields.instructions: Large heading on the left, e.g. "Контакти".

sub_fields.label: Columns
sub_fields.name: columns
sub_fields.instructions: Contact columns, in this order (up to 3 per row on desktop); drag to reorder. A column without lines is not shown.

sub_fields.label: Label
sub_fields.name: label
sub_fields.instructions: Small caption above the column, e.g. "Соцмережі", "Пошта", "Телефон / адреса".

sub_fields.label: Lines
sub_fields.name: lines
sub_fields.instructions: One line per row. Add a link to make the line clickable.

sub_fields.label: Text
sub_fields.name: text
sub_fields.instructions: What is shown, e.g. "Instagram", "hello@lofu.com.ua", "Київ, вул. …".

sub_fields.label: Link
sub_fields.name: link
sub_fields.instructions: Optional: https://…, mailto:… or tel:…. Website links open in a new tab.

description: Home page sections (template-parts/home-page/*.php): About, Concepts, Projects, Products, Production, Partners, Contacts.
